auditor_value: W = 30 N (T in the 45° string = 30√2 ≈ 42.4 N)

findings.quote: Assuming the diagonal string's two components must differ since the string is drawn at an angle, missing that 45° makes sin45° equal cos45°, so W also equals 30 N.
findings.note: This is not a concrete student error: it names no wrong equation and no wrong number a student would reach, only a vague 'assumption'. A mistake entry should describe an error path with its wrong result.
findings.fix: Resolving the 45° string's components the wrong way round (using cos45° for the horizontal part) still gives 30 N here only because sin45° = cos45°; at any other angle this swap gives a wrong W.

notes: Horizontal: T sin45° = 30 N gives T = 30√2 N; vertical: W = T cos45° = 30 N. All equation lines correct; mistake entry [1] (W = 42.4 N) is genuine.
